verdict.rationale: 2FAS is a local-first authenticator and password manager, and it has no user-defined automation or workflow layer to version, review, or roll back. Its llms.txt states 'Public API: None', so this story asks about the wrong kind of product. The GitHub 'code review' mentions are about contributing to the open-source code, and vault backup and recovery cover user data, not automations, so neither makes the axis apply.
